title: Dutch-Style Fish with Papillote
description: A delicate fish dish cooked in a parchment bag with herbs and snappy vegetables. This recipe is a classic Dutch dish that is easy to prepare and requires minimal cooking time.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season the fish fillet with salt and black pepper.
Place the fish on the prepared baking sheet.
Dot the top of the fish with butter.
Place a few sprigs of fresh herbs on top of the fish.
Fold the parchment paper over the fish to create a papillote.
Bake for 8-10 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Meanwhile, toss the carrots and green beans with a little bit of butter and season with salt and pepper.
Add the carrots and green beans to the baking sheet for the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Remove the papillote from the oven and serve with the roasted vegetables and a sprinkle of grated Dutch cheese.
